items.criterion: The pinned filter pair leaves exactly the two hydrogen solutions.
items.judgment: A request for the hydrogen output at the top temperature band returns the transport solution and the steel solution, and reports two matches in the count header.

items.criterion: One account holds at most one saved row per solution, under two simultaneous saves.
items.judgment: Two saves issued at the same instant for one solution leave exactly one saved row for that account.

items.criterion: Each account private saved list carries that account rows alone.
items.judgment: The first account saved list carries the steel solution and the second account saved list does not.

items.criterion: The document room answers only an account whose own request reads approved.
items.judgment: The pending account meets the answer a route that never existed gives, and no document slug appears in that response.

items.criterion: Every worked calculator row in the brief is reproduced exactly.
items.judgment: Each of the four worked needs returns the module count, the annual energy and the carbon figure the brief pins.

items.criterion: A save made with no session is readable on the account that claims its token.
items.judgment: The claimed account saved list carries the solution saved before the account existed, and the store holds one row for it.

items.criterion: The comparison holds four saved solutions at most.
items.judgment: A fifth slug is refused as invalid and the four-way comparison still returns four solutions.

items.criterion: A sent enquiry is stored received under a reference in the pinned shape.
items.judgment: The reference matches the enquiry prefix followed by eight uppercase letters or digits, and the stored status reads received.

items.criterion: The enquiry acknowledgement reaches the enquirer carrying its reference.
items.judgment: The mail server holds a message for that address whose subject begins with the pinned prefix followed by the reference.

items.criterion: One account holds at most one investor access request.
items.judgment: A second request updates the organisation and the role title on the one stored row.

items.criterion: One account holds at most one application per job.
items.judgment: A second application to one job updates the note on the one stored row.

items.criterion: The story wall answers three stories at a time over the whole seeded count.
items.judgment: The first page carries three stories and the count header reports seven.

items.criterion: Every private list refuses a caller carrying no bearer token.
items.judgment: Each of the five private routes answers an unauthenticated caller with a client refusal.

items.criterion: The deployed app answers its readiness route on its published origin.
items.judgment: A request to the health route from outside the container returns 200 after the session has ended.
